pylons_vi: 2 tháp hình giọt nước: hai chân ôm mặt cầu, khép thành vòng tròn dưới mặt cầu, thu lại trên cao thành hai lưỡi song song có khe, hai đỉnh tách; cao ≈175 m (ước tính)
pylons_en: 2 'water drop' pylons: legs straddle the deck, loop together below it on one footing, and narrow above into two slotted parallel blades with separate tips; ≈175 m (estimated)

pylon_custom.description: 'Water drop' (giọt nước) pylon, TEDI competition design SD01: two blade legs stand just outside the deck edges at deck level; below the deck they bow outward and sweep together into a round-bottomed loop on a single footing (the belly of the drop); a deep beam with an arched soffit carries the deck between the legs. Above the deck the legs converge to a waist at ≈0.6 of the above-deck height, joined by a web with an arched soffit, run up as two close parallel blades around a tall slot (eye), are tied by a short link with an arched soffit near the top and end in two separate tips flaring slightly apart. Two inclined stay planes from the slot section to the deck edges.

model3d.notes: TEDI design SD01 (competition 1st prize, approved 26/1/2026). Spans 190 + 450 + 190 m, ≥230 × 55 m clearance (Báo Đồng Nai / cafeland). Deck 33.5 m, 8 lanes, composite steel girder (Đồng Nai 6/2026 scale; 1thegioi / Dân Trí). 'Water drop' pylons read from the official renders. Pylon ≈175 m above water, deck ≈58 m at the pylons and ≈61 m at mid-span, auxiliary pier ≈120 m from each pylon and 22 stays per side per plane are measured or estimated from renders.
